**How to Get Rid of Broken Trampolines**

**META Description:** "Learn how to safely dispose of broken trampolines with 1-800-GOT-JUNK? and our comprehensive guide."

**
Getting rid of a broken trampoline can be a daunting task, but with the right approach, you can safely and efficiently dispose of it. In this article, we'll walk you through the process of removing a broken trampoline, including preparing for removal, choosing the right disposal method, and making sure your backyard is safe and clean.

### Preparing for Removal

Before you start removing your broken trampoline, it's essential to take some precautions to ensure a safe and successful process.

#### Clear the Area

Clear the area around the trampoline of any obstacles, toys, or furniture that could get in the way of removal. This will also make it easier to maneuver the trampoline and any surrounding debris.

#### Disconnect and Drain

If your trampoline has a net or padding, you'll need to remove it and set it aside. You should also drain any water from the trampoline's frame and springs to prevent any damage or mess during removal.

#### Protect Your Yard

If you have any sensitive plants or landscaping nearby, consider covering them to prevent damage from debris or chemicals.

#### Assemble Your Removal Team

If you have a large or heavy trampoline, consider enlisting the help of friends or family members to assist with removal. Alternatively, you can hire professionals from [CTA: Book 1-800-GOT-JUNK Now] to handle the job for you.

### Choosing the Right Disposal Method

Once you've prepared for removal, it's time to decide how to dispose of your broken trampoline.

#### Recycling

If your trampoline is still in relatively good condition, you may be able to recycle it. Many companies offer trampoline recycling programs that will remove and process the materials for you.

#### Donation

If your trampoline is still in good condition but no longer suitable for your family, consider donating it to a local park or community center. This can be a great way to give back to your community and keep the trampoline out of a landfill.

#### Proper Disposal

If your trampoline is beyond repair, you'll need to dispose of it properly. This can be a challenge, especially if you live in an area with strict waste management regulations. That's where [CTA: Get a Free Quote from 1-800-GOT-JUNK?] comes in – our team of experts will safely and efficiently remove your trampoline and dispose of it according to local regulations.

### Safe Trampoline Removal Tips

When removing a trampoline, it's essential to take safety precautions to avoid injury or damage.

#### Use Proper Equipment

Use a strong rope or strap to secure the trampoline to a truck or trailer, and consider using a dolly or hand truck to move it across uneven terrain.

#### Wear Protective Gear

Wear gloves, safety glasses, and a dust mask to protect yourself from sharp metal, springs, and other hazards.

#### Be Aware of Your Surroundings

Be mindful of any overhead obstructions, such as power lines or trees, and consider removing any nearby obstacles to ensure a safe and smooth removal process.

### Backyard Clean-Up

Once your trampoline is removed, you'll want to take care of any remaining debris and clean up your backyard.

#### Clean the Area

Sweep the area thoroughly to remove any debris, dust, or dirt.

#### Repair or Replace

If you've removed a trampoline that was damaged or old, consider repairing or replacing any damaged surfaces or plants.

#### Enjoy Your Clean Backyard

With your trampoline removed and your backyard clean, you can finally enjoy the space you've worked so hard to create.
